article.story: North Texas (7-3) at Tulane (5-5), Nov. 21 at 12 p.m. EST. Opening Line: North Texas by 6.5. Against the spread: North Texas 6-4, Tulane 4-6. How to watch: ESPNU Key stats North Texas Offense Overall: 512.3 yards per game (5th in FBS) Passing: 328.9 yards per game (4th) Rushing: 183.4 yards per game (39th) Scoring: 41.8 points per game (4th) North Texas Defense Overall: 392.3 yards per game (104th in FBS) Passing: 213.1 yards per game (72nd) Rushing: 179.2 yards per game (111th) Scoring: 31.3 points per game (121st) Tulane Offense Overall: 334.6 yards per game (115th in FBS) Passing: 192.9 yards per game (102nd) Rushing: 141.7 yards per game (89th) Scoring: 21 points per game (115th) Tulane Defense Overall: 419.3 yards per game (128th in FBS) Passing: 203.1 yards per game (52nd) Rushing: 216.2 yards per game (135th) Scoring: 28 points per game (99th) Tulane is 132nd in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert 47.6% of the time. North Texas ranks 13th on offense, converting on 47.7% of third downs. Tulane ranks 116th in the FBS with a -6 turnover margin, compared to North Texas' 43rd-ranked +3 margin. North Texas is 130th in the FBS averaging 75.2 penalty yards per game, compared to Tulane's 40th-ranked 48 per-game average. Tulane is 14th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 73.9% of trips. Tulane is 136th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 26:28, compared to North Texas' 32nd-ranked average of 31:35. Team leaders North Texas Passing: Tayven Jackson, 3,005 yards, 23 TDs, 6 INTs, 69.5 completion percentage Rushing: Jahiem White, 1,225 yards on 176 carries, 16 TDs Receiving: Justin Stevenson, 937 yards on 58 catches, 8 TDs Tulane Passing: Trace Johnson, 1,008 yards, 3 TDs, 7 INTs, 58.3 completion percentage Rushing: Johnnie Daniels, 542 yards on 89 carries, 6 TDs Receiving: Destyn Hill, 489 yards on 41 catches, 2 TDs Last game North Texas was beaten by UTSA 35-16 on Nov. 14. Jackson led North Texas with 125 yards on 10-of-20 passing (50.0%) for no touchdowns and one interception. Chris Jimerson Jr. had 33 rushing yards on 11 carries and one touchdown. Baron Tipton had two receptions for 63 yards. Tulane won 20-17 over Rice on Nov. 14. Johnson passed for 190 yards on 19-of-38 attempts (50.0%) with one touchdown and two interceptions. He also carried the ball four times for 32 yards. Maurice Turner had 90 rushing yards on 15 carries, adding two receptions for 24 yards. Hill had five receptions for 44 yards. Next game North Texas hosts UAB on Nov. 28. Tulane plays at South Florida on Nov. 28.
